name: Astronomy
overview: Scripture reveals God's sovereign control over the cosmos, as seen when Joshua commands the sun and moon to stand still and they obey, demonstrating the Lord's power to alter natural order for His purposes. Job affirms that God alone commands the sun and seals the stars, spreading out the heavens and shaking the earth. These passages emphasize that the celestial bodies are under divine authority, reflecting God's majesty and His active involvement in creation.
